description: This file defines the ServerRequestCreatorFactory class within the Slim Framework. It manages creation and configuration of server request creators, including detection, decoration, and external factory/provider integration.

classes.name: ServerRequestCreatorFactory
classes.description: Provides static methods for creating and determining server request creators, including configuration options and decorator application.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Returns a server request creator instance, determining the suitable implementation if not already set.

methods.name: determineServerRequestCreator
methods.description: Detects and returns an appropriate server request creator, throwing RuntimeException if none are available.

methods.name: attemptServerRequestCreatorDecoration
methods.description: Wraps the server request creator with a decorator if automatic detection is enabled and available.

methods.name: setPsr17FactoryProvider
methods.description: Sets the factory provider used for obtaining PSR-17 factories.

methods.name: setServerRequestCreator
methods.description: Explicitly sets the server request creator instance.

methods.name: setSlimHttpDecoratorsAutomaticDetection
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic detection and decoration of server request decorators.
